executiveSummary: Test Business Inc. shows moderate conversion readiness with gaps in trust signaling and technical SEO hygiene.
priorityFixNarrative: The highest-priority fix is establishing visible trust credentials on the homepage and service pages. Without professional credentials, visitors cannot verify qualifications, directly undermining conversion confidence.
conversionPathNarrative: The primary conversion path through the contact form is functional but weakly supported by trust proof.
readinessMapNarrative: Key service topics are present but lack the trust assets needed to move visitors from awareness to conversion.
contentOpportunityNarrative: Content depth is moderate. Several high-priority content opportunities exist in the MOFU and BOFU stages.
competitorNarrative: Compared to the competitor benchmark, the site shows lighter trust proof and less content depth.
trustNarrative: Trust signals are partially present. Testimonials and case studies exist, but credentials and pricing information are missing.
technicalNarrative: Technical SEO hygiene requires attention. Several pages are missing meta descriptions and image alt text.
performanceNarrative: Performance is adequate but could be improved with image optimization and caching.
internalLinkNarrative: Internal linking structure is functional but lacks contextual depth for key service pages.
limitationsNarrative: GSC was not connected, limiting search-performance analysis. Backlink data is available.
